expected_root_cause: The inotify rename handler rewrites watch descriptor paths but does not keep the watches.path lookup map synchronized. After a recursive rename, WatchList reads stale path entries and cannot accurately represent renamed descendants.
fix_summary: Update the path map while renaming each matching watch, then update the descriptor record so both lookup directions remain consistent; add rename regression coverage.
curation_notes: PR #756 changes the inotify rename path map and includes cross-platform regression-script cleanup for renamed recursive watches.
